acceptance_criteria_evidence.evidence: Unauthorized roles (non-STAFF/ADMIN) receive an explicit access-denied view with zero queue items or staff actions rendered.
Stale ticket version triggers version conflict alerts and strictly disables claim and confirmation actions.
Result-unknown action outcomes are rendered with explicit reconciliation banners and retry actions rather than false optimistic success.
10/10 unit tests pass deterministically; changes strictly confined to write_scope without credential or privacy leaks.
